moments.title: Premier League Kicks Off 2026/27 Season
moments.blurb: The new Premier League season begins this weekend with a host of exciting fixtures across Friday, Saturday, Sunday and Monday, including newly promoted Coventry City facing champions Arsenal.

angles.name: General Excitement
angles.copy: The wait is over! The Premier League is BACK this weekend. Who are you backing for glory, and who's in for a shocker on opening day?

angles.name: Promoted Teams
angles.copy: Welcome to the big time! Newly promoted Coventry City kick off their Premier League campaign against champions Arsenal on Friday. Ipswich Town and Hull City also begin their top-flight journeys. Massive weekend ahead!

angles.name: Key Fixtures
angles.copy: Arsenal vs Coventry, Hull vs Man Utd, Newcastle vs Liverpool... the Premier League opening weekend has some crackers! What's your must-watch match?

moments.title: EFL Championship: Wrexham vs Cardiff City
moments.blurb: Wrexham face fellow Welsh club Cardiff City in the EFL Championship tonight, marking a significant early season clash for both teams.

angles.name: Welsh Derby Today
angles.copy: It's a huge Welsh derby tonight in the Championship! Wrexham host Cardiff City. Who are you rooting for? Kick-off at 8pm.

angles.name: Local Pride
angles.copy: The battle for Welsh bragging rights! Wrexham and Cardiff City go head-to-head in the Championship tonight. Get behind your team!

moments.title: EFL Championship Matches This Weekend
moments.blurb: The EFL Championship continues this Saturday, August 22nd, with a full slate of fixtures including Swansea vs Sheff Utd and Derby vs Cardiff.

angles.name: Championship Saturday
angles.copy: Another big weekend in the Championship! Saturday sees Swansea take on Sheffield United, plus Cardiff City are away at Derby. Who's picking up crucial early points?

angles.name: Midlands vs Wales
angles.copy: Cardiff City travel to Derby on Saturday for their second match of the Championship season. Can they grab an away win?

moments.title: Madonna Turned 68 Yesterday
moments.blurb: The undisputed Queen of Pop, Madonna, celebrated her 68th birthday yesterday, August 16th.

angles.name: Queen of Pop's Birthday
angles.copy: Still reinventing and reigning supreme! The iconic Madonna celebrated her 68th birthday yesterday. What's your favourite Madonna era or track?

angles.name: Enduring Influence
angles.copy: From 'Like A Virgin' to 'Hung Up', Madonna has shaped pop music for decades. Happy 68th to the one and only Queen of Pop!

moments.title: Robert Plant Turns 78
moments.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin frontman Robert Plant celebrates his 78th birthday on August 20th.

angles.name: Rock Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 78th birthday this Thursday to the iconic voice of Led Zeppelin, Robert Plant! What's your ultimate Plant vocal moment?

angles.name: Golden God
angles.copy: From the thunderous highs of 'Immigrant Song' to his incredible solo work, Robert Plant is a true rock legend. Wishing him a very happy 78th birthday on August 20th!

moments.title: Andrew Garfield Turns 43
moments.blurb: Award-winning British-American actor Andrew Garfield, known for roles in 'Spider-Man' and 'The Social Network', celebrates his 43rd birthday on August 20th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Spidey
angles.copy: He's won awards, he's saved the world (a few times!). Andrew Garfield turns 43 this Thursday. What's your favourite Andrew Garfield role?

angles.name: Versatile Actor
angles.copy: From intense dramas to blockbuster superhero flicks, Andrew Garfield always delivers. Wishing the Epsom-raised actor a very happy 43rd birthday on August 20th!

moments.title: Demi Lovato Turns 34
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Demi Lovato celebrates their 34th birthday on August 20th.

angles.name: Pop Star Birthday
angles.copy: From Disney star to pop powerhouse, Demi Lovato turns 34 this Thursday! What's your go-to Demi track?

angles.name: Still Confident
angles.copy: Happy 34th birthday to the incredible Demi Lovato on August 20th! Their music has inspired so many. Celebrate with your favourite song!

moments.title: Dua Lipa Turns 31
moments.blurb: Global pop sensation Dua Lipa, known for hits like 'Levitating' and 'New Rules', celebrates her 31st birthday on August 22nd.

angles.name: Future Nostalgia Birthday
angles.copy: Get ready to dance! The fantastic Dua Lipa turns 31 this Saturday. What's the Dua Lipa song that always gets you moving?

angles.name: Pop Superstar
angles.copy: From 'New Rules' to 'Radical Optimism', Dua Lipa continues to dominate the charts. Wishing her a very happy 31st birthday on August 22nd!

moments.title: End of Summer Holidays / Back to School
moments.blurb: While Scottish schools have largely returned, the rest of the UK is gearing up for the end of the summer holidays and the return to school in early September.

angles.name: Scotland Back to School
angles.copy: Bags packed, pencils sharpened! Most Scottish schools are back in session this week. How was your summer, and how's that first week back feeling?

angles.name: Last Week of Freedom (England/Wales/NI)
angles.copy: The final countdown! For many in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland, this is the last week of the summer holidays before schools return in early September. Making the most of it?

angles.name: Devon School Returns
angles.copy: Enjoying the last few days of freedom? Devon schools are preparing to welcome students back in early September. What's on your end-of-summer bucket list?
